nurse.text: Failte, welcome to Oban Sanctuary. We take in anything that's come off a ferry looking green. That includes the creatures.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit yourself down. Have a cuppa. Don't mind the rain, it's only passing through.
There you go, right as rain. Mind how you go, and mind the gulls on the pier. They've seen you with chips.
The Ark terminal's in the corner. It runs on hot water, determination and an enormous amount of tea.

else.text: No bother at all. Away you go. Mind the puddles, they're deeper than they look.
